name: pyupgrade-annotation-evaluation-profiles
instr:
pyupgrade cannot yet select a coherent annotation evaluation profile while preserving runtime meaning across syntax rewrites and import handling. Add eager, stringized, and type-check-only profiles for consistent library and command transformations without changing existing behavior.

All declarations below are public from `pyupgrade`. `AnnotationContexts` and `analyze_annotation_contexts` classify source offsets. `AnnotationPolicy` uses each context, target version, and profile to decide rewrites. Keep callback coordinates and context decisions precise through nested functions, classes, annotations, and conditional branches.

Preserve evaluation semantics for PEP 585 generics, PEP 604 unions, annotation dequoting, PEP 696 generator shortening, PEP 646 unpacking, and lazy TYPE_CHECKING imports. Preserve established version floors, formatting, and syntax-specific exclusions for forward-reference, empty-union, alias, nested Annotated, and Literal cases without blocking safe siblings. Convert TYPE_CHECKING blocks to lazy imports only when target support and the profile make every import safe.

Use deterministic provider availability for syntax and import movement. Preserve aliases and runtime-required members of mixed imports. `availability_for` returns no record for unavailable providers. Keep positional and keyword `Settings` construction compatible. Omitting `annotation_mode` preserves the established effect of `keep_runtime_typing`. `upgrade_source` and command processing us
